homogeneity_proof: J_(scale*A)(x)=scale*J_A(x/scale), scale>0, so an accepted polynomial majorant coefficient q_(2j) scales by scale^(1-2j). Every scaled row is global.
continuous_box_proof: One fixed row is selected per entire box. Its q6>0 moment price is convex in kappa and affine in shape, so four corners bound the whole moment rectangle. Its physical r-plane is price-a*u, decreasing in u. The source cap at u_lo is therefore uniform; only boxes with source cap strictly below r_lo are excluded.
scope: Additional physical source constraints/exclusions only; the remaining global norm assembly is separate.
